description: This file defines the core structure of an entity-component system for a game or simulation, including entity class, component base classes, message handling, and component management.

classes.name: Entity
classes.description: Base class representing an entity with message handling and component access.

classes.name: AllComponents
classes.description: Template class for managing collections of components.

classes.name: Component base classes
classes.description: Base classes for specific components, generated per component type.

methods.name: Entity::Get
methods.description: Template method to retrieve a component of a specific type from an entity.

methods.name: Entity::SendMessage
methods.description: Dispatches a message to the entity's components.

methods.name: HasComponents
methods.description: Template function to check if an entity has certain components.

methods.name: ForEntities
methods.description: Template function to iterate over entities with specific components.
